name: crosstab
expr: [T, c, p] = crosstab(x, y); Tsa = crosstab(xa); [Tb, cb, pb] = crosstab(xb, yb);
comment: MATLAB crosstab: contingency table with chi-square independence test. Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b on table entries; chi2 and p match within tolerance (chi2cdf depends on incomplete-gamma which has small numerical drift between engines). Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship crosstab in core (statistics package only); reports N/A.
